relations.evidence_span: Amino acids are also sweet (Glycine, Alanine and Valine), tasteless (Leucine) or Bitter (Arginine & Isoleucine).
All amino acids except glycine possess optical isomers because of the presence of asymmetric α-carbon atoms and show optical activity.
The name zwitter is derived from the German word which implies hybrid. Zwitter ion (or) dipolar ion is a hybrid molecule containing positive & negatively ionic groups.
